items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau Urges Support
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau pleaded for LIV Golf to be given "one more shot" amid its uncertain future and ongoing 2027 funding struggles during the season finale in Indianapolis.

items.headline: McIlroy Admits Swing Issues
items.text: Rory McIlroy acknowledged he continues to face swing challenges despite an unexpected career comeback after a poor 66th-place finish at the FedEx St. Jude Classic.
